The Subtask Name: S1  
Agents:  
- Agent: WebSurfer  
  -- Action: Conducted targeted web searches for both films to gather release year/date information.  
  -- Observation: Found conflicting release years for Aanaval Mothiram (IMDb listed 1990, Wikipedia listed 1991) and Heroes Of The Street (most sources indicated 1922, but some snippets mentioned 1992).  
  -- Thought: To determine which film came out earlier, the most credible, widely published commercial release date should be considered.  
  -- Result: Gathered information indicating Heroes Of The Street was released in 1922, while Aanaval Mothiram was released in 1991.  

- Agent: Planner  
  -- Action: Analyzed the gathered information and determined the release years.  
  -- Observation: Conflicting information for Aanaval Mothiram and consistent information for Heroes Of The Street.  
  -- Thought: To ensure accuracy, the most credible sources were cross-verified.  
  -- Result: Concluded that Heroes Of The Street was released earlier than Aanaval Mothiram.
